_comment: Pins scaffold_site.py writes. A bump needs a decisions.md line. Pins are at least 14 days old: npm's min-release-age refuses newer ones.

quality_tools._comment: tools/quality/package.json: SonarJS and dependency-cruiser need the TypeScript JavaScript API, which TypeScript 7 does not ship; they run here on TypeScript 6.

cloudflare._comment: wrangler is added to the site repo when provider is cloudflare; cf and wrangler run from these pins through npx, never a global install.

astro.why: Almost no JavaScript on the wire, content in Markdown.
astro.notes: Static output by default; add an adapter only when a page needs a server. @astrojs/check needs TypeScript 6.

nextjs.why: Server rendering and metadata for pages that must be indexed.
nextjs.notes: Server components by default; a Cloudflare deploy goes through the provider's own Next adapter.

tanstack.why: Public pages rendered on the server plus a fast private app.
tanstack.notes: Public routes server-rendered for search engines; the private app is client-first. `tsr generate` writes src/routeTree.gen.ts before the type check (vite dev writes it too). typecov_ignore: the router file reads the generated route tree, whose generated code carries `as any`.

motion.notes: Added only when the spec asks for motion or 3D: pnpm add <name>@<pin>.

vercel._comment: Run through npx at this pin when site.yaml -> provider is vercel.

security_tools._comment: Scanner pins. Each sha256 is copied from the release's own checksum file when the pin is set, so a download is checked against a digest this repo holds, not one fetched next to it. A bump needs a decisions.md line, a release at least 14 days old and its new digests.

pnpm._comment: Written into pnpm-workspace.yaml of every site. minimumReleaseAge is minutes (14 days): pnpm resolves nothing newer. trustPolicy blocks a package whose publisher trust dropped; versions older than trustPolicyIgnoreAfter (6 months) are not judged, and trustPolicyExclude names a package measured to trip it with no incident (chromium-bidi, under lighthouse: a release published without publisher evidence). strictDepBuilds fails on an install script nobody approved (built_dependencies). Overrides force a patched transitive release, picked at least 14 days old; drop one when its parent moves past it. minimumReleaseAgeExclude lets one exact security release in before 14 days: only when an advisory's fix is younger than that (next 16.4.1 fixes GHSA-2464-fhr4-w9xw, an unauthenticated RCE, and GHSA-p3m5-59mp-jv5r); exact versions only, never a name alone; drop the entry once the release is 14 days old.
